claims.text: The dataset used in the paper consists of tweets classified into harassment and non-harassment categories, with further sub-categories of indirect harassment, sexual harassment, and physical harassment.
The dataset includes a train set, a validation set, and a test set, published for a workshop on online harassment categorization.
The dataset is imbalanced, particularly with rare categories in the train set compared to the validation and test sets.
